purpose: Native DECODE-side port of the settled score-native carrier primitives in src/tac/boundary_math/. Payload-cleanliness manifest per CLAUDE.md 'Native eval-time runtime discipline': declares what bytes the ARCHIVE carries vs what the BINARY carries.
task: #58 (operator: lower settled score-native carrier decode primitives into Rust)

what_the_archive_carries.contour_payload: The RAW-LZMA2-compressed per-pixel uint8 SegNet argmax label map (the partition L*). This is the score-relevant, video-derived data. It lives in archive.zip and is byte-charged in the rate term (25*B/D). The Rust decoder READS it; it does NOT embed it.

what_the_binary_carries.decode_logic: FIXED, rate-free decode code: RAW-LZMA2 decompress + reshape (contour), popcount-XOR (d_seg), raster flood-fill 4-connectivity (connected components).
what_the_binary_carries.rationale: Per CLAUDE.md 'Native eval-time runtime discipline': native eval-time code is FORBIDDEN as a carrier for any learned or video-derived constant outside archive.zip. The binary is the decoder BODY; the data is the archive payload.
